Director, Product Design (Individual Contributor)

This is a senior individual contributor role carrying Director-level scope without direct reports. You will operate as a hands-on design executor and strategic influencer across multiple lines of business.

What you'll do:
- Personally own end-to-end design delivery for high-priority initiatives across several product portfolios simultaneously.
- Influence stakeholders at the executive level; evangelize design thinking to partners who are new to working with design.
- Drive adoption of design practices across teams that do not currently engage with design; prove design's value through wins.
- Connect dots across LOBs, championing consistent experiences in a federated organization.
- Operate with extreme ownership in a high-velocity environment; we move fast and wear many hats.
- No direct reports; you may informally guide junior designers as capacity allows, but people development is not part of this role's scope.

About you:
- 10+ years as a hands-on designer; comfortable being measured on personal design output and stakeholder influence rather than team outcomes.
- Energized by winning over skeptical executives and building buy-in from scratch.

Remote eligible within the United States.
